We need to find which template actually matches our molecule. We can test each template using check_smiles_reaction_template_matching. The result includes template_id (but we have only template_hash). Need template_id field? The search result dict includes reaction_id, template_hash, etc. It doesn't include template_id. Maybe template_id is same as reaction_id? Actually template_id is separate. But we can use reaction_id as template_id? The description says template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). Likely template_id is reaction_id. We'll assume template_id = reaction_id.
